Author: bdg
Name: FATE Hopper
Punchline: Click an Occult Crescent FATE to shard-hop toward it.
Description: Shows the active FATEs in the Occult Crescent - South Horn and North Horn - as a clickable list, like the one Vanilla Plus draws. Clicking a FATE teleports you to the aetheryte shard nearest to it, through the Lifestream plugin - you have to be standing within range of any shard already, the same as using one by hand; the plugin picks the destination and does the clicking. The window opens by itself when you enter the zone and can be toggled with /fatehopper.
